raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Clients that abort in-flight requests and keep the partial outputs rely on one routed-experts row per returned token. For a request that holds no KV (queued, retracted, or mid-chunk) the scheduler echoes the abort and the tokenizer answers with the tokens it has seen so far. A retracted request has already produced tokens, but their routed experts went away with its KV, so a non-streaming `return_routed_experts` response carries N output tokens, N logprobs and no routed experts.

## Modifications

- `TokenizerManager._handle_abort_req`: for a non-streaming request with `return_routed_experts`, the abort echo returns no output tokens, empty output-side logprob lists, `completion_tokens=0` and an empty `routed_experts`; the weight versions are computed for the tokens actually returned. Streaming requests (which already received their tokens) and requests without routed experts are unchanged.
- `sampling_params.mdx`: one sentence on this case (queued, retracted or mid-chunk requests) below the parameter table.
- `test/registered/unit/managers/test_tokenizer_manager_rid_cleanup.py` (CPU): the non-streaming echo has no tokens, no output logprobs and empty routed experts (fails on main), and its weight versions cover the 0 tokens it returns; the streaming echo keeps its tokens.

A related fix for client aborts that land in a step reaching a stop or the length cap is a separate PR ("[Fix] scheduler: let a client abort yield to the stop or length cap of its step").

## Accuracy Tests

`Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B`, TP1, `--enable-return-routed-experts --max-total-tokens 8192`, upstream's forced-retraction test knob (`SGLANG_TEST_RETRACT=1 SGLANG_TEST_RETRACT_INTERVAL=10`). 32 concurrent non-streaming greedy requests (`max_new_tokens=1024`, `return_logprob`, `return_routed_experts`), then `abort_all` after 15 s. Baseline `8d4e1ce4c7` and this PR on the same GPU in the same container (GB300 runs use `--moe-runner-backend triton`).

| | main | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| abort echoes with tokens and logprobs but no routed experts, per run of 32 requests | 1x GB300: 10-13 (4 runs: 13, 13, 10, 11); 1x GB200: 13 (1 run); 1x H100: 10-18 (3 runs: 10, 18, 18) | 0 in every run (those echoes return 0 tokens, 0 logprobs, 0 rows) |
| running requests aborted (rows = prompt + completion - 1) | 7, consistent | 7, consistent |

The count on main depends on which requests are retracted when the abort lands, so it varies from run to run; on this PR it is 0 in every run. Requests that are not aborted, and streaming requests, run the same code as before.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No speed impact: the change runs only on abort echoes.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). BUGFIX evidence above; generated tokens are unchanged, only abort echoes are affected (no gsm8k run). No speed change.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

files.patch: @@ -117,6 +117,8 @@ The `/generate` endpoint accepts the following parameters in JSON format. For de +With `return_routed_experts`, a non-streaming request aborted while it holds no KV cache (queued, retracted or mid-chunk) returns no output tokens, no output logprobs and an empty `routed_experts`, because the routing of its earlier tokens is gone. + ## Sampling parameters The object is defined at `sampling_params.py::SamplingParams`. You can also read the source code to find more arguments and docs.

@@ -3711,17 +3711,24 @@ def _handle_abort_req(self, recv_obj: AbortReq):
             "weight_version": self.config_value("weight_version"),
             "e2e_latency": state.time_stats.get_e2e_latency(),
         }
+        is_stream = getattr(state.obj, "stream", False)
+        # The scheduler echoes an abort only for a request that holds no KV
+        # (queued, retracted or mid-chunk), so the routed experts of the tokens
+        # it produced are gone. A non-streaming reply then carries no output
+        # tokens rather than tokens without routed-experts rows.
+        drop_output = not is_stream and getattr(
+            state.obj, "return_routed_experts", False
+        )
         if recv_obj.weight_versions is not None:
             add_weight_versions_to_meta_info(
                 meta_info,
                 recv_obj.weight_versions,
-                num_output_tokens=len(state.output_ids),
+                num_output_tokens=(0 if drop_output else len(state.output_ids)),
             )
         if prefill_spans := recv_obj.prefill_weight_versions:
             meta_info["prefill_weight_versions"] = weight_version_spans_to_json(
                 prefill_spans
             )
-        is_stream = getattr(state.obj, "stream", False)
         if getattr(state.obj, "return_logprob", False):
             self.add_logprob_to_meta_info(
                 meta_info,
@@ -3734,11 +3741,20 @@ def _handle_abort_req(self, recv_obj: AbortReq):
             )
 
         output_ids = state.output_ids
+        text = state.get_text()
+        if drop_output:
+            output_ids, text = [], ""
+            meta_info["routed_experts"] = ""
+            for key in _INCREMENTAL_STREAMING_META_INFO_KEYS:
+                if key in meta_info:
+                    meta_info[key] = []
+            if "output_token_logprobs_length" in meta_info:
+                meta_info["output_token_logprobs_length"] = 0
         meta_info["completion_tokens"] = len(output_ids)
         if is_stream and self.incremental_streaming_output:
             output_ids = [output_ids[-1]] if len(output_ids) > 0 else []
         out = {
-            "text": state.get_text(),
+            "text": text,
             "output_ids": output_ids,
             "meta_info": meta_info,
         }

@@ -50,6 +50,7 @@
     SchedulerReqTimeStats,
 )
 from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_context
+from sglang.srt.utils.weight_versions import WeightVersionSpan  # noqa: E402
 
 register_cpu_ci(est_time=11, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
 
@@ -157,6 +158,7 @@ def _make_req_state(rid: str = "test_rid") -> ReqState:
     obj.rid = rid
     obj.stream = False
     obj.return_logprob = False
+    obj.return_routed_experts = False
     obj.lora_path = None
     obj.log_metrics = False
     return ReqState(
@@ -493,6 +495,72 @@ def test_abort_output_ids_match_the_streaming_mode(self):
                 self.assertEqual(out["output_ids"], expected)
                 self.assertEqual(out["meta_info"]["completion_tokens"], 3)
 
+    def test_abort_with_routed_experts_returns_no_output(self):
+        """An abort echo has no routed-experts rows, so a request that asked
+        for them gets no output tokens and no output logprobs either."""
+        tm = _make_tokenizer_manager(self)
+        rid = "abort_routed_experts_rid"
+        state = _make_req_state(rid)
+        state.obj.return_routed_experts = True
+        state.obj.return_logprob = True
+        state.obj.top_logprobs_num = 0
+        state.obj.token_ids_logprob = None
+        state.obj.return_text_in_logprobs = False
+        state.output_ids = [5, 6, 7]
+        state.output_token_logprobs_val = [-0.1, -0.2, -0.3]
+        state.output_token_logprobs_idx = [5, 6, 7]
+        tm.rid_to_state[rid] = state
+
+        tm._handle_abort_req(_make_abort_req(rid))
+
+        out = state.out_list[0]
+        self.assertEqual(out["output_ids"], [])
+        self.assertEqual(out["text"], "")
+        meta = out["meta_info"]
+        self.assertEqual(meta["completion_tokens"], 0)
+        self.assertEqual(meta["routed_experts"], "")
+        self.assertEqual(meta["output_token_logprobs"], [])
+        self.assertEqual(meta["output_token_logprobs_length"], 0)
+
+    def test_blanked_abort_echo_reports_weight_versions_of_no_tokens(self):
+        """The weight versions of a blanked echo describe the 0 returned tokens."""
+        tm = _make_tokenizer_manager(self)
+        rid = "abort_routed_experts_versions_rid"
+        state = _make_req_state(rid)
+        state.obj.return_routed_experts = True
+        state.output_ids = [5, 6, 7]
+        tm.rid_to_state[rid] = state
+        abort = _make_abort_req(rid)
+        abort.weight_versions = [
+            WeightVersionSpan(version="v1", start=0, end=2),
+            WeightVersionSpan(version="v2", start=2, end=3),
+        ]
+
+        tm._handle_abort_req(abort)
+
+        meta = state.out_list[0]["meta_info"]
+        self.assertEqual(meta["completion_tokens"], 0)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            meta["weight_versions"], [{"version": "v1", "start": 0, "end": 0}]
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(meta["weight_version"], "v1")
+
+    def test_streaming_abort_with_routed_experts_keeps_tokens(self):
+        """A streaming client has already received the tokens; the final abort
+        chunk is not blanked."""
+        tm = _make_tokenizer_manager(self)
+        rid = "abort_routed_experts_stream_rid"
+        state = _make_req_state(rid)
+        state.obj.stream = True
+        state.obj.return_routed_experts = True
+        state.output_ids = [5, 6, 7]
+        tm.rid_to_state[rid] = state
+
+        tm._handle_abort_req(_make_abort_req(rid))
+
+        self.assertEqual(state.out_list[0]["meta_info"]["completion_tokens"], 3)
+        self.assertNotIn("routed_experts", state.out_list[0]["meta_info"])
+
 
 class TestRidToStateCleanupOnBatchOutput(CustomTestCase):
     """Test that _handle_batch_output removes rid from rid_to_state on completion."""
